out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: 1) limes for garnish
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. STAFF DISCARDED THE CUT LIME. WEAR GLOVES WHEN CUTTING LIMES. WEAR GLOVES OR USE A UTENSIL TO GARNISH DRINKS AND OTHER FOODS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the bar hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACE PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK. ALL HAND SINK MUST HAVE PAPER TOWELS TO FACILITATE PROPER HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Handsink at the bar was observed being used as a dump sink
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT THAT HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY. MANAGEMENT DISCARDED SMOOTHIES IN THE TRASH.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Proper Temp
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding to a sufficient temperature and/or time: 1) beer cheese
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REHEAT BEER CHEESE IN THE OVEN OR GRILL TO 165f BEFORE HOT HOLDING AT A MINIMUM OF 135f.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Stored bowls and containers on shelves were observed with dust and debris from when the pipe in the ceiling burst
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CLEAN ALL FOOD EQUIPMENT BEFORE NEXT SEASON.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Shelving and exterior of coolers were observed with dust and debris from when the pipe in the ceiling burst
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CLEAN ALL SURFACES BEFORE NEXT SEASON.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Entire kitchen was observed with remnants of dust and debris from when the ceiling pipe burst.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. DEEP CLEAN ENTIRE KITCHEN BEFORE NEXT SEASON.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the prep sink in the front area leaking from the faucet
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR THIS FAUCET. PIC STATES HE WILL PLACE A WORK ORDER FOR THIS REPAIR.
